purpose: Define `$EXT` as explicit registration/addressing metadata for external peers/resources, read-only by default and never itself an authorization grant.

topics.name: EXT Registration Authority
topics.purpose: Define `$EXT` as explicit registration/addressing metadata for external peers/resources, read-only by default and never itself an authorization grant.

semantics.uniqueness_rule: External identity/address registration is unique according to declared EXT identity constraints.
semantics.readonly_rule: Registered external resources are read-only by default unless explicit governed mutation semantics exist.
semantics.address_rule: EXT registration supplies external addressing/discovery metadata.
semantics.authority_rule: Registration or successful ping does not grant DWH or AccessCore rights.
semantics.ac_rule: When AccessCore is active, direct `$EXT` dereference cannot bypass the governed DWH remote path.
semantics.mutation_rule: EXT registry mutations are explicit governed operations.
semantics.trace_rule: Registration changes retain actor, old/new binding and result.

invariants.rule: DWH applies data-boundary policy at the origin and target independently; remote addressing, transport reachability and external registration never substitute for AccessCore authorization.

hard_gates.condition: AC-active direct EXT dereference bypasses DWH

prose.summary: Define `$EXT` as explicit registration/addressing metadata for external peers/resources, read-only by default and never itself an authorization grant.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH, EXT, AccessCore and transport contracts.
